name: Greased Floor (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades

disable: DC 16 Survival check or DC 16 Thievery check to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.

items.name: Slip and Slide
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks into the greased area

---
Effect The triggering creature must make a successful DC 14 Acrobatics check check to avoid falling Prone. The area is uneven ground.

text: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.
